parameters.content:
## 1 · Intake
Header-auth webhook (`X-BookLeaf-Key`). Validates payload, de-duplicates per author (static data, 120 s), answers Bubble **immediately** with 202 / 400 / 409 so the admin UI never waits on the AI.

## 2 · Fetch from Bubble Data API
Bubble is the source of truth, so n8n pulls the author, books, payouts and the as-of date by ID instead of trusting a payload. Each call retries 3× then routes to the failure path.

## 3 · AI
Deterministic facts (totals, payout dates, scenario) are computed in code; Claude only writes. The reply is checked for name, pending total, production updates and invented ₹ amounts.

## 4 · Output & status callback
SMTP email (bonus) + POST to Bubble backend workflow `summary_callback` with Success/Failed, content and timestamp. All error branches converge on **Build failure payload**.
